files.rationale: Add the signup endpoint to the existing auth routes file that already handles login and forgot-password.
Extend the existing UserCredentials model to include the fullName field required for signup, reusing the model as specified.

summary: The plan modifies the existing auth routes file to include the new signup endpoint and extends the UserCredentials model to support the fullName field. It introduces bcryptjs for password hashing and requires JWT_SECRET for token generation, aligning with the existing authentication infrastructure from the Login feature.
